<noinclude>
This is a generic infobox template for consistent page layouts across lab content.

== Usage ==
<pre>
{{Infobox
|title=Page Title
|name=Item Name
|status=Active
|owner=[[Personnel:John Doe]]
|created_date=2025-01-15
|last_updated=2025-01-20
|content=Additional content here
}}
</pre>

== Parameters ==
* title - Title of the infobox (default: "Infobox")
* name - Name of the item
* status - Status (Active, Inactive, Archived, etc.)
* owner - Link to personnel page
* created_date - Creation date (YYYY-MM-DD)
* last_updated - Last update date (YYYY-MM-DD)
* content - Additional content to display

[[Category:Template]]
</noinclude>
